description: ARPSI, area de riesgo potencial de inundaciones is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.euskadi.eus. Area of potential flood risk. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "ARPSI, potential flood risk area" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
